project: Dental Cavity Detection: image-level enamel caries classification
source_citation: Himel, G. M. S.; Islam, M. M.; Hannan, U. H. (2023). Caries-Spectra: A dataset of Enamel Caries, V2. DOI: 10.17632/9jnf2jvghy.2
similarity_method: 64-bit pHash over 8 rotations/reflections; connected components, Hamming distance <=4
split_rule: Approximately 70%/15%/15%; no image-similarity group crosses a split
patient_independence: Not established: no verified patient IDs are provided in these files. Similarity groups are not patient IDs.
changes: Excluded the extra [Originals] subfolder and exact duplicate copies; renamed classes and filenames; grouped similar images before splitting. Original retained JPEG bytes are unchanged.
task: Three-class image classification. No bounding boxes or segmentation masks are supplied.
